default_note: 'dense' is the DEFAULT and is the behaviour every BANKED refav1 number was produced under — the parameter itself did not exist before commit 4139203
headline: Under the DEFAULT grid 'dense' (the one every banked number was produced under), 62/64 (lat, lon) token pairs give a DIFFERENT tactical action sequence to the goal and to the seed that chases it; the agreeing pairs are [('LANE_KEEP', 'CRUISE'), ('ABORT_LC', 'CRUISE')]. The canonical seed therefore cannot score 1-cos = 0 against its own goal even with a perfect world model. Worst heading excess: 82.506 deg on TURN_L.
